description:
Port upstream resource-loader.ts getSystemPrompt() and getAppendSystemPrompt() to Elixir.

Upstream behavior:
- getSystemPrompt(): reads {cwd}/.pi/SYSTEM.md if exists, else ~/.pi/SYSTEM.md if exists, else undefined
  → feeds custom_prompt opt in SystemPrompt.render/1 (replaces default body entirely)
- getAppendSystemPrompt(): reads both ~/.pi/APPEND_SYSTEM.md AND {cwd}/.pi/APPEND_SYSTEM.md
  → both loaded; joined with "\n\n" → feeds append opt in SystemPrompt.render/1
  → project append is applied after global append

Implementation:
- Add to OctoPi.Coder.ResourceLoader (or a new PromptFiles submodule)
- load_system_prompt/1 — project-local first, then global fallback, returns string | nil
- load_append_system_prompt/1 — load both global + project, join with "\n\n", return string | nil

Tests:
- Project SYSTEM.md present → used as custom_prompt
- Project absent, global present → global used
- Neither present → nil (default body used)
- Append: only global → global content
- Append: only project → project content
- Append: both → global + "\n\n" + project content
- Empty files → treated as absent (nil)

Reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts getSystemPrompt(), getAppendSystemPrompt()
title: System prompt file and append system prompt file loading
